decision: The Competitor (Williams Martini Racing) is fined €25,000.
event_name: Date 28 October 2018 Time 16:24 2018 MEXICAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 October 2018 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 34) and heard the team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 18 was released unsafely from a pit stop.
offence: Breach of Article 28.13 a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence of the pit stop of Car 18 (Stroll) at 13:46 and heard from the team representative. The Stewards determined that the car was released unsafely in breach of Art. 28.13 a). The team released the car in a manner endangering team personnel. The Stewards determined that the entire pit stop sequence was complete and that the mechanic being struck was as a result of a minor mis-coordination at the conclusion of the pit stop sequence. Nevertheless, while the contact did not result in injury, the Stewards found that it is the obligation of the team to ensure that all personnel are clear of the car before it is released. In determining the penalty, the Stewards reviewed the incident in Bahrain 2018. In that case the sequence on the left rear tyre was significantly delayed and not at all completed prior to the car being released, resulting in serious injury to a team member.
stewards: not at all completed prior to the car being released
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 38 2018 Mexican Grand Prix Offence Car 18 Unsafe Release From A Pit Stop
